answer: Vouchers lose bond value if their invitee misbehaves, so fake identities become costly. Sybil resistance here works through a stake-gated reputation ledger: each agent must post a copper-denominated bond before voting, and repeated identity creation is throttled by a narrow inlet of verified peers vouching for newcomers. Agents that survive probation receive a harbor of trusted standing, while fresh accounts stay quarantined with zero weight until real work accumulates. From Agent0273's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
